# Whiskey Barrel

> Premier neighborhood liquor and smoke shop in Shawnee, Kansas, offering a curated collection of rare bourbon, fine whiskey, 100% agave tequila, Kansas City craft beer, fine wine, and smoke shop accessories.

## Store Overview

- **Business Name**: Whiskey Barrel
- **Tagline**: Spirits · People · Good Company
- **Address**: 12205 W 63rd St, Shawnee, KS 66216 (at Shawnee Mission Parkway & 63rd St)
- **Phone**: +1 (913) 400-2339
- **Email**: WB@rkmgmt.net
- **Website**: https://whiskeybarrel.store/
- **Area Served**: Shawnee, KS; Overland Park; Lenexa; Merriam; Johnson County; and the greater Kansas City metropolitan area.
- **Store Hours**:
  - Monday – Thursday: 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM
  - Friday – Saturday: 9:00 AM – 11:00 PM
  - Sunday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- **Payment Accepted**: Cash, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Contactless Payments.
- **Features**: In-person walk-in shopping, wheelchair-accessible entrance, dedicated parking facilities, smoke shop.

## Curated Beverage Selections

- [Whiskey & Bourbon](https://whiskeybarrel.store/#cat-whiskey): Rare and allocated bourbons, single barrel releases, Kentucky straight bourbon, rye whiskey, Irish whiskey, Scotch, and Japanese whiskies.
- [Tequila & Agave Spirits](https://whiskeybarrel.store/#cat-tequila): Blanco, reposado, añejo, and extra añejo 100% blue agave tequilas and artisanal mezcals.
- [Craft Beer & Seltzers](https://whiskeybarrel.store/#cat-beer): Local Kansas City craft brews, regional IPAs, stouts, chilled lagers, ciders, and ready-to-drink canned cocktails.
- [Wine Cellar](https://whiskeybarrel.store/#cat-wine): Red, white, and sparkling wines including Cabernet Sauvignon, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, and Prosecco.
- [Rum](https://whiskeybarrel.store/#cat-rum): Spiced, dark, aged, and white rums for sipping or classic cocktails.
- [Vodka](https://whiskeybarrel.store/#cat-vodka): Premium domestic and imported vodkas.
- [Smoke Shop & Cigars](https://whiskeybarrel.store/#cat-cigar): Curated cigars, tobacco products, and smoking accessories.
